snippet.title: Heavy Duty Inc. | Itch Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Heavy Duty Inc. is a Turn-based Tactics Roguelite Hybrid with charming voxel visuals that can be played as a chill single-player or Co-Op with your friends.

Play the Singleplayer Demo on itch.io ▹ https://heavydutyinc.itch.io/heavy-duty-inc 
Wishlist the full game on Steam ▹ https://store.steampowered.com/app/4154670/Heavy_Duty_Inc/
Join our community on Discord ▹ https://discord.gg/wuyqbzqejr
